1.t: Super Sprint" Video PCB Assembly EPROMs

Some of the integrated circuits on the Video Printed-Circuit Board (PCB) Assembly were inadvertently omitted from the Super Sprint Operators Manual. This supplement contains the part numbers of those erasable programmable read-only memory (EPROM) integrated circuits.
Set of Integrated Circuits Located on the Video PCB Assembly (Atari Part No. A043665-01)
